lines.en: Short in stature, quick on my feet.
Golden hair up, I dash forward.
One toe-touch and I slide a long way.
I fly low along the ground.
My ki pushes me along.
Small frame, small drag.
I land so lightly it barely counts.
I curve around the boulder.

lines.zh: 这边的人，个头都比我高。
lines.en: Everyone here is taller than me.
I am looking for someone worth fighting.
My clothes brush the grass tops.
I can go faster still.
Ki turns in my palm.
I breathe deep and steady my face.
I am not fully used to this form.
I look up at the sky.
My stomach is a bit empty.
The golden flame rises and falls on me.
I am thinking about my training.
It is quiet. Too quiet.
The enemy is not here yet.
I ease my ki down to save it.
I have made a small dent underfoot.
A bird crosses the distance.
You are taller than me, but it does not matter.
I have your ki measured.
Let us have a fight.
Your eyes are tense.
Do not relax just because I am small.
The golden hair stands out, does it not?
Can you stop a ki blast?
I look at you sidelong.
Are you the only one around here?
I will give you one free move.
I do not like bullying people.
I have your stance memorised.
Wondering whether I will strike?
I bared my teeth.
Relax. Let us talk first.
There is no ki in your hands.
I raise a palm toward you.
Are you ready?
That hurts! Really hurts.
I moved a step back.
Small, but I can take a hit.
I grind my teeth.
Blood runs from my nose.
Your force is bigger than your frame.
I gather my ki again.
My golden hair lifts; I straighten up.
Something to eat? Give it here.
Waiting until after training is too long.
I know this smell.
I can eat three portions.
Leave me some; do not carry it all off.
I will grow after I eat.
The smell steadies my ki.
I am taking this one.
You cook well.
Is there a next pot?
I am too short; I hit your waist.
My ki shields me. It does not hurt.
You get pushed a step back.
Sorry, I came in too fast.
We knocked out a sound between us.
I roll and land on my feet.
You are really strong.
I plant my feet and hold.
Shrugged that off? Again—with ki this time.
I will go easier this time.
Spar with me: you attack, I defend.

lines.zh: 个子小的，也有快的打法。
lines.en: Small fighters have fast ways.
I have seen that move before.
I will show you how to hold a ki blast.
Sit down if you are tired.
Two auras are easier to read together.
Coming back tomorrow?
I will get stronger.
Training is more fun with you here.
Remember the rhythm of this move.
I hop up to reach it.
In my hand, it is fairly heavy.
What lands on the ground, I keep.
Can this be eaten?
I stuff it in my pocket.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，气弹随手一扔。
lines.en: I leap up and toss a ki blast.
It is awkward to walk with.
Leave it. I will come back.
I do not waste things.
Then we fight.
I kick off the ground.
My target is you.
I gather ki, my palm heating.
I have read your move.
Then let us go.
I press my ki down.
I am fighting seriously this time.
Do not try to slip away.
Ki gathers in my palm; I strike first.
This is the moment I waited for.
I can match your speed.
We are beginning.
I circle along your flank.
Being short has its advantages.

lines.zh: 你的拳头从上往下，正好落空。
lines.en: Your punch comes down and misses.
Ki blasts, one after another.
I wait for your hands to drop.
The gap is down to three blocks.

lines.zh: 你在看我的头，我在看你的脚。
lines.en: You watch my head; I watch your feet.
This form burns ki.
Just that little bit.
Your armour will not stop the light.
One more circle to check.
I know which way you will dodge.
Eyes on you the whole time.
Keep my breathing in time.
This shot will land.
You have backed to the wall.
This is a good opening.
Basic combo, first hit.
Fist after fist, no pause.
I leap and hit your jaw.
A kick into your knee.
The hit drives you back.
The ki in my palm released.
I am small enough to slip through gaps.
That punch went through air.
Another ki blast.
You block steadily.
That one carried weight.
Do not take this one head-on.
I spin and add a palm strike.
The matter is not over.
My ki is not spent.
I draw my strike back.
Not tall, but my ki is no small thing.
I have come out of the mission.
A boy drops onto the ground.
Golden hair stands in the wind.
I look up at you.
The ki here is a mess.
I am a Super Saiyan.
The ground shuddered once.
I still remember my master's moves.
Let me see what is here first.
The wind lifts my clothes.
I let my ki spread out slowly.
I did not come to play.
Three hundred health is enough.
Get ready.
On landing, my ki kicks up dust.
I stand my ground.
Fire came and I jumped clear.
I misjudged the landing.
Underwater my ki is not enough.
The blast scattered my aura.
Something came in from the side.
This is not ki. Strange.
Hunger and my ki will not rise.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我头发都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and scorched my hair.
No ground here; I am floating.
